info.title: Job Getter API
info.description: Generated from the TypeBox contracts in packages/contracts by packages/contracts/scripts/generate.ts. Do not edit by hand. JSON snake_case, ISO-8601 UTC timestamps, UUID identifiers. The API derives the workspace from the authenticated principal and never trusts a client workspace_id.
